derived_quantities.description: Higher of actual (billed) weight and the 25 kg minimum chargeable weight

charges.label: Freight on chargeable weight
charges.quote: consignments under 50 kg: ₹9.50 per kg of chargeable weight; consignments over 50 kg: ₹8.25 per kg of chargeable weight

charges.label: Protected-handling fee for fragile consignments
charges.quote: Consignments booked as fragile are handled under the Carrier's protected-handling process at ₹150.00 per consignment, in addition to freight.

invoice_adjustments.label: 5% volume incentive discount on monthly invoice total
invoice_adjustments.quote: In any calendar month in which the Customer tenders more than 12 consignments, the Carrier will apply a 5% discount to the invoice total for that month's invoice.

ambiguities.description: The rate schedule prices consignments 'under 50 kg' (lt 50) at ₹9.50/kg and 'over 50 kg' (gt 50) at ₹8.25/kg, but states no rate for chargeable weight exactly equal to 50 kg. This leaves a gap in the rate card that this spec does not close.

The contract states express products are not offered under this agreement, so no rate is defined for a shipment with service_level = express even though that value exists in the shipment schema. Any such shipment falls outside this contract's scope.

notes: Rate revision notice (§7, 60 days) and 30-day payment terms (§6) are administrative, not pricing rules, and are not encoded as charges or document_rules. No provision exists for cold_chain or residential special_handling, so no charge applies for those flags (not treated as an ambiguity, since the contract simply does not address them). Ambiguities: (1) exact 50 kg chargeable weight falls in the gap between the 'under 50 kg' and 'over 50 kg' rate bands; (2) express service is explicitly stated as not offered, so shipments with service_level=express have no defined rate under this contract.
